title: Pukka Juice Tropical Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: Tropical by Pukka Juice is exactly as exotic and uplifting as it sounds, with a perfect blend of tangy passionfruit, juicy kiwifruit and refreshing watermelon. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
